emojis.summary: The Yemeni government said the ship was carrying food supplies to a port on the Bab al-Mandab Strait. The Iran-backed Houthis have not commented on the attack.

emojis.summary: The former president was convicted of crimes against humanity during the country’s civil war, the first verdict since he fled to Russia in 2024.
